checks.why: a line inserted directly after a method's docstring is a change to THAT METHOD: the docstring is the first line of its body, not a blank line between declarations, so the edit used to be charged to the class and name no declaration

a line inserted one statement further into the body names the method and only the method: the insertion is already accounted for as a body change, so it is not also listed as unattributed new lines inside the class
